checks.details: All pages include proper landmarks: header, nav, main, aside, footer
H1 → H2 → H3 structure properly maintained throughout
All meaningful images include descriptive alt attributes. Decorative images marked with aria-hidden or role='presentation'
lang='en' and xml:lang='en' properly set in <html> tags
Text/background contrast ratios verified: Body text (charcoal on cream) >7:1, Headings >4.5:1
nav.xhtml includes proper epub:type='toc' and hierarchical structure
content.opf includes language, title, and proper EPUB 3 metadata
Spine order matches logical book structure (frontmatter → body → backmatter)
CSS includes page-break-inside: avoid for critical sections
Interactive worksheets use proper <label> associations (id/for attributes)
Tables use <th> elements with scope attributes where present
All links have descriptive text or aria-label attributes
No audio or video present (static content only)
Six font variants embedded (Libre Baskerville: regular/italic/bold, Cinzel Decorative, Montserrat: regular/bold)

recommendations: Consider adding page-list navigation for print-equivalent page numbers (optional enhancement)
Consider adding index navigation if creating future editions (optional)
All WCAG 2.1 AA requirements currently met - no critical actions needed
conclusion: The EPUB demonstrates excellent accessibility compliance and is suitable for distribution to all audiences, including those using assistive technologies.
next_steps: Proceed to content analysis phase. No accessibility fixes required.
